    • isPartial

      public boolean isPartial()
      Checks if the page is partial. If the page is partial, fewer items are shown on it than is described by getPerPage.
      Returns:
      true if the page is partial, false otherwise

    • getPerPage

      public int getPerPage()
      Gets the number of items shown on the page in this paginator. This may be different than the number of items on getOnPage() for the last page if teh page is incomplete (the list does not exactly divide into the number of items per page).
      Returns:
      the number of items on a page

    • isValidPage

      public static boolean isValidPage(List<?> list, int page, int perPage)
      Checks if page is valid for a given list (of any type). A page is not valid if there are not enough items in the list for the first item to be shown on that page. The only exception is page 1 wchich will always be valid unless the number of items per page is invalid (non-positive).
      Parameters:
      list - the list of items
      page - the page in question
      perPage - number of items per page
      Returns:
      true if page exists, false otherwise

    • paginate

      public static <T> void paginate(List<T> list, int page, int perPage, Consumer<T> worker)
      Paginates the given page of the given list by doing the work as specified by the worker. If the intput (page, per page) is incorrect, an exception is thrown.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of items in the list
      Parameters:
      list - the list of items to paginate
      page - the page to work on
      perPage - number of items per page
      worker - the worker for items on the page
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if page and/or perPage is incorrect
